verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents an app for desktop as well as mobile and web, with codes syncing end-to-end encrypted across devices. Desktop-specific features include type-to-search, right-click edit and delete, QR-image import, an optional macOS menu bar mode, and an official Flathub listing. A community user also reports switching to it after Authy dropped its desktop app. Missing for 10: an explicit documented list of supported desktop OSes or installers, and independent hands-on review of the desktop app itself.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile

citations.quote: Auth has an app for every platform. Mobile, desktop and web. Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
Added type-to-search on desktop for faster code lookup
Added an optional menu bar mode on macOS for quick access to your 2FA codes
You can delete or edit a code by long pressing (or right clicking on desktop) on that item.
Auth is now officially available on [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/io.ente.auth)!
